title: Elf Bar Plus50 Spearmint Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Spearmint from the Elf Bar Plus50 refill pod range offers a crisp, refreshing mint flavour with a naturally sweet edge. The cool inhale is balanced by the gentle sweetness of spearmint, making for a clean, smooth and satisfying vape. Each Plus50 pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and can join two other pods in the Elf Bar Plus50 Pod Kit, with no mess or fuss. The integrated mesh coil delivers consistently smooth performance with discreet vapour, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Each pod is topped up via a prefilled 10ml refill pod, and together each pod and refill can deliver up to 5,500 puffs of flavour.
